findings.frozenDecision: 华能国际 Research selection; not High-priority because timing was neutral, expectation burden tight, prior rerating large, peer asymmetry mixed, and the 2022 recovery was already substantially embedded in consensus.
findings.label: turnaround_expectation_already_embedded_correctly_blocked
findings.generalLesson: A credible regulatory spread reset does not justify High-priority when consensus already embeds a large earnings rebound, the stock has rerated ahead of realized recovery, and a cheaper peer can capture the same mechanism.

findings.frozenDecision: 盐湖股份 Research selection; not High-priority because broad lithium timing was adverse and the selected-vs-赣锋 edge remained mixed despite a credible v1.2 full-path case.
findings.interpretation: The frozen research selection showed strong 60d relative alpha and beat matched peers, but absolute return was approximately flat and the later peer ranking reversed. This is useful recall evidence, not sufficient proof that the adverse-timing or clear-asymmetry High-priority gates should be loosened.
findings.generalLesson: A credible expectation-path advantage can justify keeping a name in Research through an adverse regime, but one relative-success case is not enough to promote mixed-asymmetry selections into Primary.

findings.frozenDecision: DRAM downcycle hypothesis / No selection because company-level differentiated earnings resilience was not verified.
findings.label: negative_cycle_no_selection_preserved
findings.generalLesson: An explicit industry downturn should remain unselected until a listed company demonstrates auditable economic differentiation; stale historical earnings are not a bottom signal.

durableCashYieldQuestion.interpretation: No second independent company/industry in this window reproduces the Shenhua pattern of stable normalized earnings plus durable cash distribution generating missed High-priority alpha. The evidence remains insufficient for a v1.3 cash-yield extension.

decision.reason: V1.2 correctly blocked 华能 and preserved 盐湖 as Research. The previously observed Shenhua durability/cash-yield false negative did not independently repeat in 2021Q4.
decision.nextAction: Run unchanged V1.2 on another untouched historical window with a different economic mix. Continue recording both false positives and false negatives, and only version a new gate after a failure class repeats across companies and industries.

prohibitedUses: Do not upgrade V1.2 from the same-period Salt Lake 60d relative success.
Do not weaken adverse-timing or clear-asymmetry requirements from one Research winner.

Do not use Salt Lake 120d peer reversal to rewrite the pre-registered 60d result.
